verdict.rationale: Supabase docs explicitly describe a Branching feature that creates isolated preview environments 'for each pull request' and can be managed via the CLI and Management API, enabling programmatic creation/teardown from CI. Community threads confirm Supabase was actively building this as 'Preview Databases' to move users off manual dashboard edits toward CI-driven workflows. Missing for 10: a concrete CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions) integration example and confirmation of automatic teardown on PR close.
